results.title: Launch Your Chrome Extension on Product Hunt
results.snippet: For a detailed walkthrough on optimizing your store page, read how to optimize your Chrome Web Store listing for maximum installs. You should also have your onboarding flow ready. results.title: Can You Make Money Building a Chrome Extension? - Tinkrd
results.snippet: Diversifying your user acquisition so you are not entirely dependent on the Web Store ranking is the most practical hedge against those risks. Building a Chrome extension is a legitimate path to indie income. The tools are accessible, the distribution channel exists, and the costs to start are low. The builders who earn consistently are the ones who picked a specific problem, priced honestly, and kept maintaining the product after launch.

results.title: Loom Growth Teardown: Chrome Extension to $975M Exit
results.snippet: Loom reached 25 million users by its 2023 exit through three zero-cost plays. A Chrome extension put “Recorded with Loom” branding on every shared video, so each viewer became a potential signup.
